sentences.en: After an arduous journey across the mountains, the refugees finally reached the border, exhausted but relieved.

sentences.en: Despite its popularity, the diet is supported by very little empirical evidence from controlled clinical trials.

sentences.en: Several economists expressed serious reservations about the proposal, arguing that it could fuel inflation without boosting long-term growth.

sentences.en: Despite her initial reservations, she accepted the overseas posting and soon found the experience enormously rewarding.

sentences.en: The government moved swiftly to contain the outbreak, closing schools and restricting travel within days of the first reported case.

sentences.en: When the interviewer raised the scandal, the minister swiftly changed the subject to the economy's recent performance.

sentences.en: The doctor listened sympathetically as the elderly patient described the loneliness she had felt since her husband's death.
sentences.ko: 그 의사는 나이 든 환자가 남편이 죽은 이후 느껴 온 외로움을 이야기하는 동안 공감하며 귀를 기울였다.

sentences.en: The novel portrays its flawed protagonist sympathetically, inviting readers to understand rather than judge his choices.
sentences.ko: 그 소설은 결점 있는 주인공을 동정적으로 그려, 독자들이 그의 선택을 판단하기보다 이해하도록 이끈다.

sentences.en: Irate passengers crowded the check-in desk after the airline cancelled dozens of flights without offering any explanation.
sentences.ko: 그 항공사가 아무런 설명도 없이 수십 편의 항공편을 취소하자 격노한 승객들이 탑승 수속 창구로 몰려들었다.

sentences.en: The mayor received hundreds of irate emails from residents who opposed the plan to build a highway through the park.

sentences.en: The coach nodded encouragingly as the nervous rookie stepped up to take the decisive penalty in front of a packed stadium.
sentences.ko: 코치는 긴장한 신인 선수가 꽉 찬 경기장 앞에서 결정적인 페널티킥을 차러 나서자 격려하듯 고개를 끄덕였다.

sentences.en: Her mentor smiled encouragingly whenever she hesitated during the presentation, which gave her the confidence to finish strongly.
sentences.ko: 그녀의 멘토는 그녀가 발표 중에 머뭇거릴 때마다 격려하듯 미소 지었고, 이는 그녀에게 강하게 마무리할 자신감을 주었다.

sentences.en: Encouragingly, the latest figures show that youth unemployment has fallen for the third consecutive quarter.

sentences.en: The trial was small, but, more encouragingly, patients reported few side effects even at the highest dose.
sentences.ko: 그 임상시험은 소규모였지만, 더 고무적이게도 환자들은 최고 용량에서도 부작용을 거의 보고하지 않았다.

sentences.en: Being claustrophobic, he always takes the stairs rather than squeeze into a crowded lift with strangers.
sentences.ko: 폐소공포증이 있어서, 그는 낯선 사람들과 붐비는 엘리베이터에 끼어 타기보다 항상 계단을 이용한다.

sentences.en: Many patients feel claustrophobic inside an MRI scanner, so some hospitals now offer open models or mild sedation.
sentences.ko: 많은 환자들이 MRI 촬영기 안에서 폐소공포를 느끼므로, 일부 병원은 이제 개방형 모델이나 가벼운 진정제를 제공한다.

sentences.en: The tiny studio flat felt so claustrophobic that she spent most evenings working in the local library instead.
sentences.ko: 그 작은 원룸은 너무 답답하게 느껴져서 그녀는 대신 대부분의 저녁을 동네 도서관에서 일하며 보냈다.

sentences.en: Critics praised the novel for capturing the claustrophobic atmosphere of a small town where everyone knows everyone else's business.
sentences.ko: 비평가들은 모두가 서로의 일을 다 아는 작은 마을의 숨 막히는 분위기를 포착했다며 그 소설을 칭찬했다.

sentences.en: The ceasefire offered civilians a brief respite from the shelling, allowing aid convoys to reach the besieged city.
sentences.ko: 휴전은 민간인들에게 포격으로부터의 잠깐의 휴식을 주어, 구호 차량 행렬이 포위된 도시에 도달할 수 있게 했다.

sentences.en: After weeks of record temperatures, the overnight rain brought welcome respite to farmers and city dwellers alike.
sentences.ko: 수 주간의 기록적인 기온 뒤에, 밤사이 내린 비는 농부들과 도시 거주자들 모두에게 반가운 한숨 돌림을 가져다주었다.

sentences.en: Investors pulled money out of the market amid growing fears of an impending recession.
sentences.ko: 투자자들은 임박한 경기 침체에 대한 커지는 두려움 속에서 시장에서 돈을 빼냈다.

sentences.en: Residents along the coast were urged to evacuate as forecasters warned of the impending storm's unprecedented strength.
sentences.ko: 기상 예보관들이 임박한 폭풍의 전례 없는 위력을 경고하자 해안을 따라 사는 주민들은 대피하라는 권고를 받았다.

sentences.en: Academic writing relies heavily on nominalisation, turning verbs like 'decide' into nouns such as 'decision'.
sentences.ko: 학술적 글쓰기는 명사화에 크게 의존하여, 'decide' 같은 동사를 'decision' 같은 명사로 바꾼다.

sentences.en: Plain-language advocates argue that excessive nominalisation makes official documents dense, abstract and needlessly difficult for ordinary readers.
sentences.ko: 쉬운 언어 옹호자들은 과도한 명사화가 공문서를 빽빽하고 추상적이며 일반 독자들에게 불필요하게 어렵게 만든다고 주장한다.

sentences.en: Thousands gathered at the war memorial on Sunday to honour the soldiers who died defending their country.

sentences.en: The city council voted to build a memorial to the victims of the factory fire near the riverside park.
sentences.ko: 시의회는 강변 공원 근처에 공장 화재 희생자들을 위한 기념비를 세우기로 표결했다.

sentences.en: A memorial service for the late author will be held next month at the university where she once taught.
sentences.ko: 고인이 된 작가를 위한 추도식이 그녀가 한때 가르쳤던 대학에서 다음 달에 열릴 것이다.

sentences.en: The foundation established a memorial scholarship to support young scientists from low-income families across the region.
sentences.ko: 그 재단은 지역 전역의 저소득 가정 출신 젊은 과학자들을 지원하기 위해 기념 장학금을 설립했다.

sentences.en: At the ceremony, the president paid tribute to the firefighters who had risked their lives during the wildfires.
sentences.ko: 그 기념식에서 대통령은 산불 동안 목숨을 걸었던 소방관들에게 경의를 표했다.

sentences.en: The documentary pays tribute to the nurses whose quiet dedication kept hospitals running throughout the pandemic.

sentences.en: The company has pushed back the launch of its new smartphone until next spring because of supply shortages.
sentences.ko: 그 회사는 공급 부족 때문에 새 스마트폰의 출시를 내년 봄까지 연기했다.

sentences.en: Heavy rain forced the organizers to push back the start of the final match by nearly two hours.

sentences.en: Teachers' unions pushed back against the proposal, arguing it would increase workloads without improving student outcomes.

sentences.en: When regulators tried to impose stricter rules, several tech giants pushed back hard, threatening to withdraw from the market.

sentences.en: Deforestation across Southeast Asia has pushed several primate species, including orangutans, to the brink of extinction.

sentences.en: The government's failure to prepare for the flood was manifest to anyone who had followed the warnings from scientists.

sentences.en: The new manager was remarkably amenable, listening patiently to every complaint and responding with genuine courtesy.
